children.content: CAP Analysis Report: Corrective and Preventive Actions 2011-2025
This report provides a comprehensive analysis of Corrective and Preventive Actions

data spanning 2011 to 2025. The analysis covers 591 historical CAPs from the ChronoCAP database and 10 recent CAPs from the 2025 overview, offering insights into trends, costs, departmental performance, and efficiency metrics.
